categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在推理加速与缓存复用、Agent 技能与记忆的持续演化，以及垂直场景下的可信落地。

articles.title: HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
articles.zh: HandsOnAid：面向应急响应场景的离线急救助手的构建与评估
articles.summary: 如果你要做断网环境下也能用的应急AI助手，这篇从构建到评估给了一套完整参考，重点全押在"没网还能不能跑"上
articles.author: Rezwan Islam Salvi, Saiyma Sittul Muna 等
articles.body: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.
articles.bodyZh: 紧急情况下，可能既没手机信号，附近也没有救护车。这时候手机上的小型语言模型（language model）能帮上忙，但它给出的建议必须安全、准确。我们做了个叫 HandsOnAid 的东西，是一个 4 位量化的 Gemma 2B 模型，用 QLoRA 在 FirstAidQA 数据集上做了微调，这个数据集里有 5550 组急救问答。我们对比了七种配置，包括基础模型、4 位和 8 位微调模型，还有加了长度下限（length floor）、安全闸门（safety gate）或检索（retrieval）的版本。我们用一个包含 41 组问答的题库来测试，参考答案经过医学审核，遵循 ANZCOR 指南，评分用严格的 0 到 5 分评分标准（rubric），还设了 12 条安全覆盖规则。四个前沿大语言模型评委（LLM judges）——GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3——盲评了每个回答，另外用 45 个隐藏对照项来检查评委靠不靠谱。微调把平均分比基础模型提高了 1.08 分，达到 2.34 分。最好的配置拿到 5 分里的 2.51 分，是加了检索的 4 位微调模型。还有一位医学专业人士也对 40 个回答做了盲评，覆盖基础模型、4 位微调模型和带检索的配置，打分和几个大语言模型评委的平均分差不多。关键词审计发现，训练语料里对 ANZCOR 指南中一些细节的覆盖有限，而评分标准又要求这些细节，这说明训练数据里缺信息，可能是分数偏低的一个原因。在一台 Pixel 7 Pro 手机上，用六个 CPU 线程、不联网，4 位微调模型在十个问题上平均 6.86 秒出现第一段能显示的文字，14.88 秒给出完整回答。

articles.title: Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study
articles.zh: KV Cache 能否跨模型更新复用？一项 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 案例研究
articles.summary: 如果你指望升级模型版本后还能直接复用旧缓存来省算力，这篇会用实测告诉你哪些能留、哪些必须重算
articles.author: Zhikun Tao, Fangyong Jin 等
articles.body: Reusing key--value (KV) caches across language model updates could avoid repeated computation of shared context, but changes in model weights raise a fundamental question about what these caches preserve. We investigate direct cache reuse across four model updates, with a detailed study of DeepSeek-V4-Flash to Flash-0731. Our central finding is that caches can retain useful task information without faithfully reproducing the updated model's behavior. Retrieval accuracy varies substantially across updates, ranging from near-native performance to large losses. With source caches already available, reuse achieves median time-to-first-token speedups of $2.10$--$5.08\times$ on three longer-prefix QA benchmarks. To characterize the behavioral differences behind these outcomes, we introduce Functional Cache Divergence, which compares next-token distributions under reused and native caches. Direct KV cache reuse better preserves native model behavior in natural-text continuation, whereas compatibility degrades with increasing prefix length in single-token retrieval tasks. Answer-margin analyses help explain how correct retrieval decisions survive substantial internal state changes. Yet even agreement on the first generated token does not ensure agreement in answer content or stopping behavior. These findings establish task utility and fidelity to native inference as distinct criteria for evaluating cross-version KV cache reuse.
articles.bodyZh: 语言模型更新时，如果能直接复用之前的键值（key-value，KV）缓存，就有机会省掉对共享上下文的重复计算；但模型权重一变，就会带来一个根本问题：这些缓存到底还保留了什么。我们研究了四次模型更新之间的直接缓存复用，并重点分析了从 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 到 Flash-0731 的变化。核心发现是：缓存可以保留有用的任务信息，但并不一定能忠实复现更新后模型的行为。不同更新之间，检索准确率差别很大，有的几乎接近原生模型，有的则大幅下降。在源缓存已经存在的情况下，复用能让三个长前缀问答（QA）基准上的首 token 延迟（time-to-first-token）中位数加速 2.10 到 5.08 倍。为了刻画这些结果背后的行为差异，我们提出了“功能缓存差异”（Functional Cache Divergence），用来比较复用缓存和原生缓存下下一个 token 的分布。直接复用 KV 缓存，在自然文本续写中更能保住原生模型的行为；但在单 token 检索任务里，前缀越长，兼容性越差。答案边际（answer-margin）分析有助于解释：为什么即使内部状态发生很大变化，正确的检索决策仍能保留下来。不过，就算生成的第一个 token 一致，也不代表答案内容或停止行为一致。这些发现说明，评估跨版本 KV 缓存复用时，“任务上有用”和“对原生推理的忠实度”是两个不同的标准。

articles.title: Thermodynamics of words
articles.summary: 如果你想给语言分布找个统计物理的解释框架，这篇把词当热力学系统来量，思路新但偏理论，先别指望直接落地
articles.author: Klaus M. Frahm, Dima L. Shepelyansky
articles.body: We introduce the word thermalization hypothesis according to which in a literary work there are effective interactions between words that drive them to thermalization where their word frequency distribution is the same as for the phenomenon of Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation. In this concept, the different words play a role of classical oscillators (particles) and their word frequencies, or related tokens, are analogous to certain filling factors over energy state levels. The thermalization process is characterized by the conservation of total system energy, or total number of words/tokens, and total probability norm, or total number of different words. We apply this approach to analyze 16 literary works, including Bible, complete works of Shakespeare, and data from American National Corpus. We show that for these cases the effective system energy is very low and thus there is the RJ condensation phenomenon with a big fraction of total probability concentrated at the lowest energy states corresponding to a big fraction of rare words appearing only once or twice in the whole text. Such a RJ condensation is observed for light propagation in multimode optical fibers and other physical systems. We relate the thermalization of words to the recently proposed wealth thermalization for households in world countries. The economy concepts of Lorenz and Pareto curves, and also Zipf curves, are applied to the word frequency distributions of the selected 16 cases and it is shown that the thermalization theory gives a strikingly good description of real data.
articles.bodyZh: 我们提出一个概念，叫“词热化假说”（thermalization hypothesis）。意思是说，在一部文学作品里，词和词之间存在有效的相互作用，会把它们推向热化；热化之后，词频分布会跟瑞利-金斯（Rayleigh-Jeans，RJ）热化与凝聚现象里的分布一样。在这个概念里，不同的单词扮演经典振子（classical oscillators，可以看成粒子）的角色，而单词的频率，或者相关的词元（tokens），类似于能态能级上的某种填充因子（filling factors）。这个热化过程的特点是：系统总能量守恒，也就是总词数/词元数守恒；总概率范数（total probability norm）也守恒，也就是不同单词的总数守恒。我们把这个方法用来分析16部文学作品，包括《圣经》、莎士比亚全集，以及美国国家语料库（American National Corpus）的数据。我们发现，这些案例里有效系统能量很低，所以会出现RJ凝聚现象：总概率很大一部分集中在最低能态，对应着很大一部分稀有词——这些词整篇文本里只出现一两次。这种RJ凝聚在多模光纤（multimode optical fibers）中的光传播和其他物理系统里也能观察到。我们还把词的热化和最近提出的世界各国、各地区家庭财富热化（wealth thermalization）联系起来。我们把洛伦兹曲线（Lorenz curve）、帕累托曲线（Pareto curve），还有齐普夫曲线（Zipf curve）这些经济学概念，套用到选出的16个案例的词频分布上，结果发现热化理论对真实数据的描述出奇地好。

articles.title: MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese
articles.zh: MISO-BR：巴西葡萄牙语厌女言论检测开放语料库
articles.summary: 如果你做多语种内容审核，这个开源语料补上了巴西葡语的空缺，但用之前注意它只覆盖单一语言和单一毒性类型
articles.author: Fábio A. S. Passos, Péricles B. C. Miranda 等
articles.body: Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss' kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 macro-F1 and are precision-oriented but recall-poor. The transformers reach 0.833 macro-F1 and accuracy (Wilson 95% CI for accuracy [0.77, 0.88]), a gap of roughly 16 points, while Base and Large are indistinguishable on the test set despite a 2.6x difference in training cost. We argue that the value of the resource lies less in its headline scores than in the auditability of its pipeline, and we state three limits that users must reckon with: the artificial class balance, whose effect on precision under realistic prevalence we quantify; the association between provenance and label, which the released source field makes measurable; and the selection bias induced by lexicon-guided sampling and automatic triage. The corpus, annotation guide, models and experimental scripts are publicly available.
articles.bodyZh: 厌女症是针对巴西用户的网络仇恨言论中最常见的形式之一，但专门针对巴西葡萄牙语的公开、可审计资源仍然稀缺。我们推出MISO-BR——一个开放、有文档记录、带版本管理的语料库，包含896条标注了二元厌女标签的平衡社交媒体文本，并随其构建协议和可复现基线一同发布。该语料库结合了从X平台基于词典和目标引导的抓取、从OLID-BR导入的条目、一个大语言模型（LLM）初筛阶段（其提示词和解码参数均已公开），以及三名标注者按照书面指南进行的人工标注。在816条条目上，标注者间信度达到Fleiss' kappa值0.788。在单一固定协议下，我们比较了四种经典分类器（多项式朴素贝叶斯和伯努利朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM和随机森林）与微调后的BERTimbau Base和Large。经典模型的macro-F1集中在0.651到0.676之间，偏向精确率但召回率较低。Transformer模型达到0.833的macro-F1和准确率（准确率的Wilson 95%置信区间为[0.77, 0.88]），差距约为16个百分点；而Base和Large在测试集上无法区分，尽管训练成本相差2.6倍。我们认为，这个资源的价值与其说在于其 headline 分数，不如说在于其流程的可审计性。我们列出了使用者必须面对的三个局限：人工类别平衡——我们量化了它在真实 prevalence 下对精确率的影响；来源与标签之间的关联——通过公开的source字段可以测量；以及词典引导采样和自动初筛引入的选择偏差。语料库、标注指南、模型和实验脚本均已公开。

articles.title: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
articles.zh: 基于条件偏移的少步流式视频生成
articles.summary: 如果你在追实时视频生成，这篇把采样步数压到极少还做成流式，值得看它把延迟和画质的平衡点推到了哪
articles.author: Deyuan Liu, Jungang Li 等
articles.body: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation using the same parameters. This removes the independent fake network while retaining S2-Avatar's frozen reference teacher, Self-Replay Forcing, and perceptual regularization. We evaluate APEX on 180-second videos using three backbone evaluations per block and a one-step spatial Refiner, with a 70-case human study and a 320-case StreamAV-Bench comparison. Compared with S2-Avatar, APEX achieves higher video instruction fulfillment on the Progressive track (3.856 versus 3.831) and higher visual aesthetics across both tracks (0.641898 versus 0.632606). Human raters favor APEX most strongly on instruction following, with +30.0% net preference, followed by consistency and video quality at +4.3% each. Motion quality favors S2-Avatar, audiovisual synchronization is predominantly tied, and usability is unchanged. Separate measurements under matched training settings show 4.4% lower peak allocated GPU memory per GPU and 9.2% shorter mean iteration time than DMD.
articles.bodyZh: 少步采样能降低流式视频生成的成本。分布匹配蒸馏（Distribution Matching Distillation, DMD）要靠一个单独的伪评分网络（fake-score network）来监督少步生成器，这会增加训练显存和计算量，而且这个网络还得跟着不断变化的生成器走。我们把 APEX 扩展到流式视频：用条件偏移（condition shifting）在生成器内部估计生成分布（generated distribution）的速度场（velocity field）。原来的文本条件负责选生成，偏移后的条件则用同一套参数负责选伪估计（fake estimation）。这样就去掉了独立的伪网络，同时保留 S2-Avatar 的冻结参考教师（frozen reference teacher）、Self-Replay Forcing 和感知正则化（perceptual regularization）。我们在 180 秒视频上评估 APEX，每个块做三次骨干评估，再加一个单步空间细化器（spatial Refiner），并做了 70 个案例的人工研究和 320 个案例的 StreamAV-Bench 对比。和 S2-Avatar 相比，APEX 在 Progressive 赛道上的视频指令满足度更高（3.856 对 3.831），两个赛道上的视觉美感也都更高（0.641898 对 0.632606）。人工评分者在指令遵循上最偏向 APEX，净偏好为 +30.0%；一致性和视频质量各为 +4.3%。运动质量上 S2-Avatar 更占优，音画同步基本打平，可用性没有变化。在相同训练设置下单独测量显示，相比 DMD，APEX 每块 GPU 的峰值已分配显存低 4.4%，平均迭代时间短 9.2%。

articles.title: Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution
articles.zh: 程序辅助的可补丁式技能演化
articles.summary: 如果你在搭能自我进化的 Agent 技能库，这篇用"打补丁"代替整体重写，更接近工程上真正能维护的做法
articles.author: Jiahao Wang, Yuqi Xiong 等
articles.body: Agent skills have emerged as an effective means of enabling LLM agents to solve complex, interactive tasks by encoding reusable knowledge without modifying model parameters. Recent approaches further improve skill adaptation by distilling reusable experience from agent execution trajectories and evolving skills based on downstream task feedback. However, existing methods primarily represent skills as natural language documents, intertwining procedural logic with descriptive knowledge and making skills difficult to maintain and evolve. To address this limitation, we propose PASE (Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution), a program-aided framework that iteratively evolves skills by associating them with executable programs. Unlike prior approaches that encode trajectory-derived experience primarily in natural language, PASE separates reusable procedural logic into editable programs, enabling targeted updates to executable components while reducing the need to repeatedly revise natural language skills. Extensive experiments across diverse models and benchmarks demonstrate that PASE consistently outperforms all baselines, by achieving over 2.8% improvements. Further analyses show that PASE exhibits greater evolutionary stability and generalisation capability, highlighting the critical role of programmatic knowledge in skill evolution. We will release all data and code via GitHub.
articles.bodyZh: Agent 技能（Agent skills）现在已经成了一种很有效的手段，能让 LLM 智能体（LLM agents）在不改模型参数的情况下，把可复用的知识编码进去，从而解决复杂的交互任务。最近一些方法又进一步提升了技能适配（skill adaptation）能力：它们从智能体的执行轨迹（execution trajectories）里提炼可复用经验，再根据下游任务反馈（downstream task feedback）来进化技能。不过，现有方法大多把技能表示成自然语言文档（natural language documents），把操作流程和描述性知识混在一起，导致技能很难维护、也很难进化。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PASE（Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution，程序辅助的可补丁式技能进化），这是一个程序辅助框架，通过把技能和可执行程序（executable programs）关联起来，迭代地进化技能。跟以前主要用自然语言来编码轨迹经验不同，PASE 把可复用的流程逻辑拆成可编辑程序（editable programs），这样就能有针对性地更新可执行部分，同时减少反复修改自然语言技能的需要。在多种模型和基准（benchmarks）上做的大量实验表明，PASE 稳定胜过所有基线（baselines），提升超过 2.8%。进一步分析显示，PASE 在进化稳定性（evolutionary stability）和泛化能力（generalisation capability）上表现更强，这也说明程序化知识（programmatic knowledge）在技能进化里起着关键作用。我们会通过 GitHub 发布所有数据和代码。

articles.title: Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation
articles.zh: 交织解剖检查与诊断推理的可解释放射报告生成
articles.summary: 如果你做医疗影像报告生成又怕被质疑黑箱，这篇让解剖定位和诊断推理交替推进，解释链条更站得住
articles.author: Chentao Huang, Runlong Lin 等
articles.body: Automated radiology report generation can draft clinically plausible reports, yet the pathway from visual evidence to reported findings remains opaque, leaving the diagnostic basis of these reports unexplained and the generated reports difficult to review or revise. We introduce ARIVE (Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence), an explainable report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning prior to final report composition. To support this process, we constructed 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) trajectories from MIMIC-CXR, wherein visual evidence from inspected anatomical regions informs subsequent clinical interpretation. Trained on these trajectories and further optimized using anatomical and clinical-content rewards, ARIVE achieved superior clinical-efficacy performance compared with strong baselines on MIMIC-CXR and the abnormality-centered MIMIC-ABN. ARIVE's reports were competitive with those of leading models in blinded expert grading, and its MCoT trajectories earned high ratings for diagnostic traceability. Furthermore, a paired review evaluation suggests that access to MCoT can aid in identifying errors within generated reports.
articles.bodyZh: 自动化的放射科报告生成（Automated radiology report generation）已经能起草临床上看着靠谱的报告，但从影像证据到报告结论，中间这条路仍然不透明，导致这些报告到底凭什么下诊断说不清，生成出来的报告也很难审阅和修改。为此，我们提出了ARIVE（Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence，解剖引导、穿插视觉证据的推理），这是一个可解释的报告生成框架：它在最终撰写报告之前，把解剖结构检查和诊断推理穿插在一起进行。为了支撑这个过程，我们从MIMIC-CXR构建了159,416条多模态思维链（multimodal chain-of-thought, MCoT）轨迹，在这些轨迹里，检查过的解剖区域所提供的视觉证据会指导后续的临床解读。基于这些轨迹训练，并进一步用解剖层面和临床内容层面的奖励来优化，ARIVE在MIMIC-CXR和以异常为中心的MIMIC-ABN上，临床效能（clinical-efficacy）表现优于强基线。在专家盲评打分中，ARIVE生成的报告跟领先模型比也不落下风，它的MCoT轨迹在诊断可追溯性（diagnostic traceability）上也拿到了高分。此外，一项配对审阅评估（paired review evaluation）表明，能查看MCoT有助于发现生成报告里的错误。

articles.title: Personalized Memory Rubrics: Learning What to Remember per User via Rubric-Guided Credit Assignment
articles.zh: 个性化记忆准则：通过准则引导的信用分配学习每个用户该记什么
articles.summary: 如果你在做带长期记忆的个性化助手，这篇解决的是"该记什么、该忘什么"的取舍，而不是继续往上下文里堆东西
articles.author: Yupeng Han, Kai Zhang 等
articles.body: Long-horizon personalized agents maintain an evolving memory by continuously deciding what to add, modify, or discard. However, learning an optimal update policy remains challenging. Conventional training relies solely on terminal question-answering accuracy, yielding a coarse feedback signal that treats all intermediate updates identically. Furthermore, update utility is inherently user-specific, as identical memory actions may yield opposite effects across different user personas. Existing methods fail to address this heterogeneity, relying on globally shared evaluation standards with at most a single scalar intermediate reward. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Personalized Memory Rubrics} (\textbf{PMR}), a framework that translates terminal feedback into fine-grained, per-step, and per-user credit assignment. PMR decomposes evaluation into a universal layer capturing cross-persona failure patterns and a per-user adaptive layer modeling individual traits as a specialized delta over the universal baseline. Through \textbf{Rubric-Guided Credit Assignment}, PMR redistributes credit at the token level, selectively amplifying validated decisions on successful trajectories while falling back to standard policy optimization on failed ones to avoid unreliable attribution. The rubric and memory policy \textbf{co-evolve} in a closed loop with anti-circularity guarantees. Crucially, PMR incurs zero inference overhead, operating without any rubric or external judge during deployment. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over strong memory-augmented baselines.
articles.bodyZh: 长周期个性化智能体（long-horizon personalized agents）会通过不断决定往记忆里加什么、改什么、删什么，来维护一份不断演化的记忆（evolving memory）。但想学出一套最优的记忆更新策略（update policy），仍然很难。传统训练只看最终问答准不准（question-answering accuracy），给出的反馈信号很粗（coarse feedback signal），把所有中间更新（intermediate updates）都当成一样。更进一步，一次更新到底有没有用，本来就因人而异：同样的记忆操作，放到不同用户画像（user personas）身上，效果可能完全相反。现有方法没解决这种差异，而是靠一套全局共享的评估标准，中间奖励最多只有一个标量（scalar）。为了解决这些问题，我们提出“个性化记忆评分细则”（Personalized Memory Rubrics，PMR）框架，把最终反馈（terminal feedback）拆成细粒度、按每一步、按每个用户来做的功劳分配（credit assignment）。PMR 把评估拆成两层：一层是通用层（universal layer），抓不同用户画像都会出现的失败模式；另一层是每个用户的自适应层（per-user adaptive layer），把个人特点建模成在通用基线（universal baseline）之上的专属偏移量（delta）。通过“评分细则引导的功劳分配”（Rubric-Guided Credit Assignment），PMR 在词元（token）级别重新分配功劳：在成功轨迹上，挑出被验证有效的决策放大信号；在失败轨迹上，则退回标准策略优化（standard policy optimization），避免给出不可靠的归因。评分细则和记忆策略（memory policy）会在闭环里共同演化（co-evolve），并且有防止循环论证的保证（anti-circularity guarantees）。关键是，PMR 不增加推理开销（inference overhead），部署时不需要任何评分细则，也不需要外部裁判（external judge）。在四个基准测试（benchmarks）上的大量实验表明，它相比强记忆增强基线（memory-augmented baselines）能稳定提升。
